title: Motor Imagery dataset from Weibo et al 2014
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing simple limb motor imagery (left hand, right hand, feet) and compound limb motor imagery (both hands, left hand with right foot, right hand with left foot), plus a rest condition. Data were recorded with a 60-channel Neuroscan system and preprocessed by bandpass filtering and downsampling to 200 Hz. The dataset supports study of oscillatory patterns (ERD/ERS), cognitive processes and effective connectivity during motor imagery, and is distributed in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier using 60 Ag/AgCl electrodes plus 2 EOG channels, nose reference and prefrontal ground, with online bandpass 0.5-100 Hz and 50 Hz notch. Participants performed kinesthetic motor imagery following visual text cues (1 s cue, 4 s imagery, 8 s trials) across 8 sections of 60 trials each covering 6 MI tasks, plus one 80-trial rest section. Data were bandpass filtered at 0.5-50 Hz and downsampled to 200 Hz.
